pairs.why: Same smooth gold candelabra in both, but B's small wax drips and slightly crisper candle cups make it read more like a built object, which the lessons favor.
A has the wax drips and slightly more defined cups, so it reads more like a real built object; B is a little plainer.
The two are nearly identical in shape, gold finish, glow and background, so neither is meaningfully closer.
The only differences are tiny ones in flame glow and base rim, and neither changes how closely it matches the real cards' finish.
Shape, gloss level and lighting are effectively the same; neither has an edge.
A has a slightly busier stem knob and B has slightly more base rings, but both are smooth gold with the same light, so it is a wash.
B's backdrop is a slightly brighter turquoise, a bit nearer the real cards' saturated backgrounds; the candelabras themselves are almost the same.
Both are the same smooth, moderately glossy gold candelabra, and their base shapes differ too little to matter.
